reviewed_original_lexeme.editorial_basis: The three original MACULA Greek word IDs have the original letter-name lemma Ἄλφα, Strong 1, noun classification and Louw–Nida lexical domain 61.7. The pinned original UBS Greek 1.0 EN and FR each contain exactly one lower-case lexical headword ἄλφα with the same independently attested lexical domain; both source original spellings are preserved, and only the individual word-level lexical HEADWORD identity is reviewed. Capitalization is not normalized in the original texts; this does not create a Strong alias or infer a contextual UBS sense.
